content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at, o.id as order_id, o.created_at as order_created_at FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id IS NULL OR o.created_at > p.created_at + 120 ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 20", "why": "Find payments that either have no order or where the order was created more than 2 minutes after payment"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Looking for payments with missing or delayed orders"}
